content:
The cslib (as in cs-lean/cslib) and CSLib (as in the project discussed in the CSLib channel) initiatives are happy to announce that we've decided to merge! You can now find us under the leanprover GitHub org at the repository https://github.com/leanprover/cslib.

Thus, if you were using cs-lean/cslib as a dependency, please point your lakefiles to leanprover/cslib now.
